name: aidd-cli
description: Optional: the aidd command on the PATH of Claude Code's Bash tool, so the agent and you type `aidd` with no other install. It runs the CLI from its own copy of aidd's source and data, with Python 3.11 or later, or uv. It is a plugin of its own because claude.ai and Cowork do not install a plugin that has a bin/ folder, so the aidd plugin stays installable there. Not on Windows, where git checks the links it is made of out as text.
